sourceReview.reason: The report describes the same October 26 launch of 24/7 secondary trading for the ChinaAMC HKD and USD Digital Money Market Funds already verified from the SFC and published as 'Hong Kong Opens 24/7 Secondary Trading for Two Tokenized Public Funds'. It adds no separate launch or material expansion.
